== frame after_cd cursor=3,28
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd project
|denv: loading .envrc
|denv: +DENV_TEST_VAR
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/project
== frame var_loaded cursor=6,28
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd project
|denv: loading .envrc
|denv: +DENV_TEST_VAR
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ echo $DENV_TEST_VAR
|loaded
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/project
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/project
